title: pyrus americana
intro: Pyrus americana, commonly known as the American Wild Pear, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that is native to eastern North America. The health benefits of Pyrus americana include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties which may aid in reducing the risk of heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus americana include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus americana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
